reuse.why: Extends the single existing isNonWorkingDay check and reuses monthUtils.dayFromDate for the formatted day.

duplication.why: The yearly-holiday match is added once, in a small isHoliday helper used by the only holiday check.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside the weekend/holiday logic it extends.

scope.why: One helper, tests and a release note; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Clear and documented; the day.slice(5) relies implicitly on the YYYY-MM-DD shape, which is a small readability cost.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks go through isNonWorkingDay
